records.decision: SCOPE LAW, binding on the kit and the serial: (1) a beat is written once - no paragraph explains a paragraph and no chapter re-tells its own events at the close; (2) no overview openings (season summaries, status reports) - open in scene; (3) after a scene, one line of consequence, never a summary of the scene; (4) budget 2,400-3,000 words a chapter, ceiling 3,400 for a chapter carrying a season's turn with the reason in its footer; (5) skip material that changes nothing (repeated readings, repeated lessons, scenery that carries neither); (6) cutting removes explanation, never the scene. All prior hard rules stand over it (house grammar, dialogue density, sentence caps, no one-sentence paragraphs, panel law, firewall, figure law).
